sources.temporalCoverage: 2020 as represented by geoBoundaries KOR ADM2; Si/Kun districts and city districts. Fixed GeoJSON has 228 features although its metadata states 229.
sources.scenarioDateCaveat: Year 2020 is the source-represented year, not certification of exact boundaries on 2020-01-01. Metadata reports 229 units but the fixed published GeoJSON contains 228; no missing polygon or parent identity is guessed. Fixed game country/coast/island/shared-border envelopes remain authoritative. Source outside the envelope and uncovered baseline residuals require independent reporting.
sources.originalCrs: OGC:CRS84 (longitude,latitude); equivalent 2D positions to EPSG:4326 under the contract axis order

preprocessing.description: Fixed geoBoundaries KOR ADM2 2020 source, 228 actual features versus 229 in upstream metadata. Preserve all source coordinates/components/holes and IDs. Only property names and CRS labels are normalized. Source parent codes are absent, so sourceParentId is null. No dissolve, clipping, simplification, snapping, filling, repair or invented boundary. Shared candidate engine performs alignment separately. Distribution license is from geoBoundaries citation/metadata, not inferred from City Population population-data terms.

Retain all 179 original shapeID feature identities and all polygon coordinates/components/holes unchanged. Map shapeName to name; sourceParentId=null because no native ADM1 field is supplied. CRS84 WGS84 values require no numeric conversion. Common pinned generator alone intersects coarse parents. No simplification, snap, repair, synthetic fill, global IDs or publication.

topology.method: Exact cancellation of shared boundaries inside complete fine-source families; promoted macro edges are existing shared fine edges.

cleanupPolicy.distanceBasis: Minimum polygon-to-existing-national/coast-line distance in local kilometers; longitude scaled by cosine of candidate latitude.
cleanupPolicy.landBasis: Only an existing source-free residual cell of the verified P0 land partition can be absorbed. A water hole has no such cell and remains unchanged.

nationalBoundaryReconciliation.policy: Existing country/coast physical partition is immutable within the established <=1e-12 degree numerical representation policy, and every original fine-source territory is retained. Explicit gameplay cleanup additionally absorbs source-free P0 land loops <=3 km² only when their entire perimeter contacts one same-country fine family, their minimum distance to that country’s existing coast/national line is <=5 km, and every loop vertex is within 5 km of that exterior linework. Internal fine/macro lines never qualify as exterior proximity. Actual P0 water holes and far inland gaps remain unchanged. Witnessed terminal splitting also permits long thin residuals <=250 km² and effective width <=2 km; the existing <=5 km general width, <=10 km original-heading ray, and unique source-pair proof remain required. Large missing land and ambiguity remain unassigned. These adjusted outlines describe gameplay territory rather than original administrative truth.

precisionNormalization.policy: Country/coast physical geometry is preserved within the existing <=1e-12 degree numerical representation policy. Final cells and edges share one noded partition; exact source coordinate bytes can be normalized.

remainingDmzResiduals.reason: No original shared-fine terminal heading reaches this residual through the same established source pair within 10 km. Preserve unassigned gameplay land instead of inventing administrative ownership.

quotient.method: Exact cancellation of shared boundaries inside complete fine-source families; promoted macro edges are existing shared fine edges.
quotient.seedInheritance: Each representative previous parent carries all seedParentIds; runtime must reject inheritance unless their complete territory states agree.
quotient.sourceFreePolicy: Original coarse residual cells retain exact IDs and geometry, with unassigned country-residual macro membership.

fineMacro.method: Exact cancellation of shared boundaries inside complete fine-source families; promoted macro edges are existing shared fine edges.
fineMacro.seedInheritance: Each representative previous parent carries all seedParentIds; runtime must reject inheritance unless their complete territory states agree.
fineMacro.sourceFreePolicy: Original coarse residual cells retain exact IDs and geometry, with unassigned country-residual macro membership.

cleanupPolicy.distanceBasis: Minimum polygon-to-existing-national/coast-line distance in local kilometers; longitude scaled by cosine of candidate latitude.
cleanupPolicy.landBasis: Only an existing source-free residual cell of the verified P0 land partition can be absorbed. A water hole has no such cell and remains unchanged.

nationalBoundaryReconciliation.policy: Existing country/coast physical partition is immutable within the established <=1e-12 degree numerical representation policy, and every original fine-source territory is retained. Explicit gameplay cleanup additionally absorbs source-free P0 land loops <=3 km² only when their entire perimeter contacts one same-country fine family, their minimum distance to that country’s existing coast/national line is <=5 km, and every loop vertex is within 5 km of that exterior linework. Internal fine/macro lines never qualify as exterior proximity. Actual P0 water holes and far inland gaps remain unchanged. Witnessed terminal splitting also permits long thin residuals <=250 km² and effective width <=2 km; the existing <=5 km general width, <=10 km original-heading ray, and unique source-pair proof remain required. Large missing land and ambiguity remain unassigned. These adjusted outlines describe gameplay territory rather than original administrative truth.

precisionNormalization.policy: Country/coast physical geometry is preserved within the existing <=1e-12 degree numerical representation policy. Final cells and edges share one noded partition; exact source coordinate bytes can be normalized.
